notes.title: 2018.6.4 Update log
notes.notes:
Urgent update for serious bugs and some new things  
1) New map: the human living room
2. Fixed the big rural areas and small villages, where players could not move around properly.
3. The small cabinet model in the kitchen has been modified. It can't be entered from below now, but it can be entered through the cabinet door.
4. The BUG "enemy bomb cannot be found" in the new Chinese tutorial fixed.
5. Added hand grenades, ball bombs, and other special items to some of the maps.
6. Fall off world camera bug fixed.
7. "Serial killing" has been added.  
9. The problem of accidentally crashing the game while disarming a bomb fixed. 
10.The ball bomb now has an initial roll speed.

notes.title: 2018/6/1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Optimized the in air resurrection spawn points. You not spawn and fall faster to get right back in the action.
Optimized map terrain to make jumping onto objects easier.
Map box refresh points increased
Added special treasure boxes the have items like hand grenades that destroy laid bombs
Added graphic quality adjustment in settings.
Version of the custom meeting room is now available. You can also add a password and modify the room’s name.
Fixed falling through world bug when killed. 
First edition of combat statistics released.
In game store, system is now available.
Combat gold coin rewards released. Use gold coins to unlock/buy items in the in game store.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Next update includes:
New game mode
New maps
New skills
New items to purchase.
Badges are under review and will be available to players soon.

notes.title: Patch Notes for – 5/29/2018
notes.notes:
New map added – The Kitchen
Optimized current maps
Basic player ranking system added
New Bomb Disposal Expert reward - Points awarded for removing enemy bombs.
New Food Expert reward - Points awarded for getting food and water.
Nuke Killer - Points awarded for killing enemies with a nuclear bomb.
Marksman – Points awarded for killing enemies with pee.
Iron head expert - Points awarded for killing enemies with farts.
Explosives expert - Points awarded for killing enemies with a bombs.
Adjusted the UI location.
Moved clothing choices to the in game mall.
Adjust the UI position after opening a room.
When you eat food, you now have a chance to double your resources.
Hand grenades can now detonate bombs already placed.
Bomb damage is reduced by up to 80 percent and the placement time has been decreased
Players who join in the middle of the game will have their armor packs strengthened according to the remaining time.
Microphone off by default.
Add new settings to the game. You can adjust sound effects, resolution, etc.
